# FAIR research software review (provisional)

This repository is a candidate for the optional [research-software FAIR profile](https://github.com/edithatogo/repository-standards/blob/main/docs/fair-research-software-standard.md). **No FAIR certification or empirical/software qualification is claimed.**

| Evidence | Required review | Disposition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Repository | Public canonical source, release history and current support | Pending |
| License and rights | Actual license grants, third-party code/data rights | Pending |
| Software registry | Verify live registry entry and versioned identity | Pending |
| Citation | Verify authorship and `CITATION.cff` / DOI accuracy | Pending |
| Quality checklist | Confirm real CI, tests, security policy and documentation | Pending |
| ARDC checklist | Complete evidence-backed [ARDC review](https://github.com/ardc-fair-checklist/ardc-fair-checklist.github.io) | Pending |
| Reproducibility | Independent fixtures, environment, commands and exact receipts | Pending |

The `fair-software.yml` action measures five public repository signals. It uses immutable upstream commit `4c11146488125aa6e1531184eed51d781bcd5871` (version 0.2.1), is read-only, and remains **advisory** because imperfect scores must not block release. A completed action run is a measurement, not an evidence audit.

**Admission:** record exact evaluated commit, hosted run and checks actually exercised; do not manufacture DOI, license, registry, attribution, badges or release status. Keep any existing security, source-rights, numerical-method, scientific and Conductor qualification gates untouched. Use the existing tools and workflows first, following [Ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail).
